title: Product Size Reference Photo to Show Scale | AIVideosUGC
description: Put your product next to a familiar object so shoppers can judge its size at a glance. AI scale photos for listings and ads, from one photo.
h1: Product Size Reference Photo Beside One Familiar Object
lead: Start a size photo, add one photo of the whole item, and name one familiar object so shoppers can judge the size at a glance.

steps.d: Upload one photo that shows the whole item. A cut-off handle, sole, or corner hides how big it is.
Name a familiar object: a palm, notebook, or carry-on. This is only a hint. Keep real measurements in the listing.
Download the square image and check that the comparison looks natural. Put the real length, width, height or capacity in the listing text.

faq.q: Is the size in the photo exact?
faq.a: No. Treat it as a visual guide. The size in the picture can be slightly off, so put the real length, width, height, or capacity in the listing text.

faq.q: Which object makes a useful size hint?
faq.a: Name one familiar, unbranded object shoppers recognize for that product, such as a hand, a notebook, a carry-on, or a common mug.

faq.q: Should each image use one reference object?
faq.a: Yes. One object keeps the comparison easy to read. Make a second image when you need a different hint.
Put length, width, height, and capacity in the listing text or a dimension table. Keep the reference photo as the quick visual beside those facts.

faq.q: Can I use this as an Amazon listing image?
faq.a: Yes. A size comparison can be one extra image in an Amazon gallery when it shows the real item. It does not replace the written dimensions.

faq.q: Where else can the square image go?
faq.a: Use it on a product page, in a Shopify gallery, or in a feed post, always next to the exact measurements.

faq.q: Can I make several size hints or use the API?
faq.a: Yes. Reuse one product photo and name another object, or send listing photos from your own software (API). Each photo is 24 credits. A failed job returns those credits.

faq.q: Do I need props or a studio?
faq.a: No. The reference object and the setting are generated from your product photo. A hand in the photo is a generated size hint, not a customer. Downloads have no watermark.

faq.q: Can shoppers judge fit from the image alone?
faq.a: They can get a rough idea of the size. A purchase still needs the exact measurements in the listing, and a size chart where fit depends on it.

faq.q: What does a size reference photo cost?
faq.a: Each product photo costs 24 credits. The cost is shown before the job starts. Starter is $24.50 a month for 200 credits.

faq.q: Can I also make a spoken clip from this photo?
faq.a: Yes. The same photo can become a short video with a script, a voice, captions, music, and an AI actor. Publish that clip to TikTok, Instagram, or Facebook, or download it. Video credits are 24, 40, 60, or 120 for 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds.
